Name: Maintain Glow Rings Indoors Radius
Author: Cloudyluna
Description:
[size=6][b]Maintain Glow Rings Indoors Radius[/b][/size]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Make glow rings emits the same outdoor’s light radius, even when indoors.

[quote]
Indoors here means within buildings or rooms, etc. The exceptions are mineshafts and volcano dungeons.[/quote]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Make glow rings emits the same outdoor’s light radius, even when indoors.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Version[/b][/size]

0.2.0

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

If you found this mod behaving weirdly or being incompatible with other mods, please report it on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27331?tab=bugs][u]bugs[/u][/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27331?tab=posts][u]posts[/u][/url] page so I can update this documentation with that information and let other users know about such potential issues in the future.

[quote]
This mod should work with most other mods unless specified otherwise below.[/quote]

[size=4][b]Compatible with multiplayer?[/b][/size]

Untested.

[size=4][b]Incompatible with[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]No known incompatibilities.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Known issues[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]No known issue.
[/list]

[size=5][b]What changed?[/b][/size]

See [url=https://github.com/cloudyluna/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/MaintainGlowRingsIndoorsRadius/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url] file for details.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 (preferably, version 1.6.10)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (minimum v4.0.0 or higher)
[/list]

[size=5][b]For users[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installing MaintainGlowRingsIndoorsRadius[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]This mod requires SMAPI, so please, install that and other listed requirements first.
[*]Unzip the files into the [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/MaintainGlowRingsIndoorsRadius[/b] game folder.
[*]Make sure the [b]MaintainGlowRingsIndoorsRadius.dll[/b] and [b]manifest.json[/b] files are inside [b]MaintainGlowRingsIndoorsRadius[/b] folder, not in [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI launcher.
[/list]
